snippet.title: SLAYER - Survive & Thrive // Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/1835490/SLAYER__Survive__Thrive/

Slayer is a fast paced combat intensive survive and thrive full throttle experience! Combat waves of enemies and make fast paced decisions to build your power! Get ready to slay hordes of enemies with just a click & swipe!
